note: Park in a quiet valley off Deadwood Ave north of Rapid City (I-90 exits 52 and 55), handy to Sturgis and Deadwood. Gravel pads with grass and picnic tables; pull-through, back-in, compact (discounted, suits camper vans) and buddy sites, plus 9 rustic cabins. Monthly winter stays need RV skirting. Rigs over 20 years old need approval before booking. No wood campfires at present. Black Hawk Creek runs through a tree-lined draw along the south edge, not past the sites. --Claude
